channel.title: PressCosmos — press releases
channel.description: Press releases distributed by PressCosmos Media Network.

item.title: Northwind Robotics raises $45M Series B to scale…
item.description: Northwind Robotics closed a $45 million Series B led by Candler Ventures to expand deployment capacity for its autonomous picking systems.

item.title: Ledgerline Financial launches real-time reconciliation for mid-market banks…
item.description: Ledgerline Financial released a real-time reconciliation engine for banks with $1–20 billion in assets, cutting month-end close from nine days to two.

item.title: Halcyon Therapeutics reports positive Phase 2 results for…
item.description: Halcyon Therapeutics reported topline Phase 2 data for HLX-204, with a 32% relative reduction in the primary composite endpoint over 24 weeks.

item.title: Verso Living opens 120-unit mass timber development in…
item.description: Verso Living opened Albina Timber Works, a 120-unit mass timber residential building in Portland, with 30 units reserved for households earning below 60% of area median income.

item.title: Arcline Logistics appoints Marta Alvés as Chief Operating…
item.description: Arcline Logistics appointed Marta Alvés as Chief Operating Officer, effective November 3, succeeding founder-led operations.

item.title: PressCosmos launches AI Visibility Suite with share-of-answer tracking…
item.description: PressCosmos released an AI Visibility Suite that formats every press release for answer engines and reports how often a brand is cited across nine AI platforms.
